description: Use this to save the user's job search criteria; each call overwrites all saved criteria, and the earlier ones are lost. Best for: the first setup, which starts the user's private desk, or a change of role, skills, salary floor or remote policy. Input tips: send target_role, skills, salary_floor in whole US dollars and remote_policy, plus optional dealbreakers; to change one field, send every field again with the change. Ask the user for any missing required field before calling. Returns status saved, the cleaned criteria and the retention note. A client with no signed-in ChatGPT user gets status not_saved: nothing is stored, and the returned criteria go to score_message as its criteria argument. Past evaluations and the scoreboard are kept. Not for scoring a pitch; use score_message.

dealbreakers.description: Optional, up to 20: constraints that rule out a pitch, such as ["Onsite required", "Legacy Java"]. Omit it or send [] for none.

remote_policy.description: Wanted work arrangement, such as "100% remote", "hybrid 1 day" or "any".

salary_floor.description: Minimum yearly base salary in whole US dollars, 0 to 10000000, such as 210000. Use 0 for no floor.

target_role.description: Target job title, such as "Staff Distributed Systems Engineer".

name: set_criteria

as_of.description: Day of the call, as YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

dealbreakers.description: Dealbreakers; empty when none were given.

retention_note.description: How long evaluations and the desk are kept, or, with not_saved, what to do next.

salary_floor.description: Minimum yearly base salary in US dollars.

source.description: Where the data comes from: the user's own private desk.

status.description: saved: the criteria replaced any earlier criteria on the user's desk. not_saved: the client sends no signed-in ChatGPT user, so nothing was stored; pass the criteria to score_message.

target_role.description: Target role, with contact details removed.

title: Set Candidate Criteria
